cohort: First-time pregnant mothers who gave birth between 2004 and 2019 in Taiwan, comprising 22,741 GDM cases and a 1:4 matched control group, along with their offspring.
finding: GDM was significantly associated with an increased risk of allergic rhinitis, atopic dermatitis, and urticaria in offspring, but not asthma; notably, no elevation in risk was observed in the GDM group receiving insulin treatment.
